低损耗粗同轴（14MHz 约 2 dB/100m），UHF/高频段表现好。: Low-loss thick coax (about 2 dB/100 m at 14 MHz); performs well on UHF and the higher bands.
入射功率与反射功率之比的分贝数，越大表示匹配越好。: The ratio of incident to reflected power in decibels; the larger the value the better the match.
反射严重，需检查天线或馈线。现代电台会自动降功率保护，不会立即损毁，但效率低下的: Severe reflection — check the antenna or feedline. Modern rigs reduce power automatically for protection and are not damaged immediately, but the loss of an inefficient feedline is magnified by repeated reflections.
反射波与入射波叠加形成的驻波最大值与最小值之比，理想为 1:1。: The ratio of the maximum to the minimum of the standing wave formed by the reflected and incident waves; ideally 1:1.
反射电压与入射电压之比，|Γ| = (VSWR-1)/(VSWR+1)。: The ratio of reflected to incident voltage; |Γ| = (VSWR−1)/(VSWR+1).
反射约 11%，回波损耗 9.5 dB，失配损耗约 0.51 dB，多数电台可正: About 11% reflected, return loss 9.5 dB, mismatch loss about 0.51 dB — most rigs work normally.
反射约 25%，回波损耗 6.0 dB，失配损耗约 1.25 dB，电台可能自动: About 25% reflected, return loss 6.0 dB, mismatch loss about 1.25 dB — the rig may reduce power automatically.
反射约 4%，回波损耗 14.0 dB，失配损耗约 0.18 dB，可接受。: About 4% reflected, return loss 14.0 dB, mismatch loss about 0.18 dB — acceptable.
完全匹配，功率全部传输。: Perfect match; all power is transferred.
平衡-不平衡转换器，连接平衡天线（偶极）与不平衡馈线（同轴），兼作阻抗变换（1:: A balanced-to-unbalanced transformer connecting a balanced antenna (dipole) to an unbalanced feedline (coax); it also serves as an impedance transformer (1:1, 4:1, 9:1).
平衡馈线，损耗极低，需配巴伦转换；450Ω 梯形线速度因子约 0.88–0.95: A balanced feedline with very low loss; it needs a balun for conversion. 450 Ω ladder line has a velocity factor of about 0.88–0.95.
惯例取**正值** RL = −20·lg|Γ| = 20·lg(1/|Γ|)；: By convention it is taken as a positive value: RL = −20·lg|Γ| = 20·lg(1/|Γ|); if the instrument shows a negative value, that is S11 (reflection coefficient in dB).
把天线系统阻抗变换到发射机所需的 50Ω，使末级输出满功率并保护功放；但不提高天: Transforms the antenna system impedance to the 50 Ω the transmitter needs, so the final stage delivers full power and the amplifier is protected; but it does not improve the antenna's radiation efficiency, nor reduce feedline loss.
极细同轴，损耗高（14MHz 约 11 dB/100m），仅用于短跳线。: Very thin coax with high loss (about 11 dB/100 m at 14 MHz); only for short patch leads.
源、馈线、负载三者阻抗一致时传输功率最大、反射最小。: When the impedances of source, feedline and load agree, transferred power is greatest and reflection smallest.
电视用，业余中用作接收与特殊匹配。速度因子随介质而异：实体聚乙烯 RG-59 约: Used for television; in amateur work for reception and special matching. The velocity factor varies with the dielectric: about 0.66 for solid-polyethylene RG-59 and about 0.82 for foam-dielectric RG-6.
粗同轴，损耗低（14MHz 约 3 dB/100m），基地台常用。: Thick coax with low loss (about 3 dB/100 m at 14 MHz); commonly used at base stations.
细同轴，损耗较高（14MHz 约 6 dB/100m），适合短距离与便携。: Thin coax with relatively high loss (about 6 dB/100 m at 14 MHz); suited to short runs and portable use.
细同轴，损耗适中（14MHz 约 4 dB/100m），常用。: Thin coax with moderate loss (about 4 dB/100 m at 14 MHz); commonly used.
